final: SELECT AVG(avg_bw) AS avg_of_avg_bandwidth, AVG(cnt) AS avg_of_counts FROM (SELECT o.observstation, o.weathprofile, AVG(t.bandusagepct) AS avg_bw, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM telescopes t JOIN observatories o ON t.observstation = o.observstation WHERE t.pointaccarc > 4.86 GROUP BY o.observstation, o.weathprofile)
